build_semi_detector: build a semi-supervised detector with teacher and student models using SemiBaseDetector
freeze_teacher_model: freeze the teacher model parameters by setting requires_grad to False
calculate_loss_supervised: calculate losses from supervised inputs and ground-truth data samples using loss_by_gt_instances
generate_pseudo_labels: generate pseudo instances from the teacher model predictions for unlabeled data
predict_with_teacher: predict detection results using the teacher model for semi-supervised inference
